description: Terminal-style replay of an actual FDEOps agent run against fictional public example records. Responses shortened for readability. No production actions or record writes.

scenes.label: Resume the customer project
scenes.prompt: @fde Pick up Garvey. What is stopping the rollout?
scenes.answer:
Security sign-off blocks the production canary.
CTO phase approval is also required.
Staging is recorded; deployment is unproven.

scenes.label: Prepare the next decision
scenes.prompt: @fde What should I take to the release review?
scenes.answer:
Bring staging evidence, security-ticket status,
CTO approval status and the rollback plan.
Acceptance: a full week of EU failures replayed,
zero manual reprocessing in the audit log,
and June Porter’s written acceptance.

scenes.label: Switch customers with the right context
scenes.prompt: @fde Switch to Kesterman. What needs my attention?
scenes.answer:
Karen’s write-back race review needs attention.
Denise needs to decide scope: three additions,
unchanged timeline.
Temporary customer selection. No records changed.
